name: Retirement Alert
query:
SELECT
    em.name AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:150",
    em.employee_name AS "Employee Name:150",
    em.custom_birth_date_ec AS "Date of Birth E.C:150",
    em.date_of_birth,
    CONCAT(
        FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, CURDATE(), DATE_ADD(em.date_of_birth, INTERVAL 60 YEAR)) / 12), ' year(s), ',
        MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, CURDATE(), DATE_ADD(em.date_of_birth, INTERVAL 60 YEAR)), 12), ' month(s), ',
        DATEDIFF(
            DATE_ADD(em.date_of_birth, INTERVAL 60 YEAR),
            DATE_ADD(
                CURDATE(),
                INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, CURDATE(), DATE_ADD(em.date_of_birth, INTERVAL 60 YEAR)) MONTH
            )
        ), ' day(s)'
    ) AS "Time Remaining to Retirement"
FROM
    `tabEmployee` em
WHERE
    em.status = 'Active'
ORDER BY
    DATE_ADD(em.date_of_birth, INTERVAL 60 YEAR);
